title: Make a practice database backup
summary: A logical dump writes SQL that can recreate database objects and rows.
introduction: A logical dump writes SQL that can recreate database objects and rows. Your task: Check that your practice dump file was created.
learningObjectives: Check that your practice dump file was created.
Explain the example for make a practice database backup

blocks.text: A logical dump writes SQL that can recreate database objects and rows. Test restoring a backup into a separate empty database.

Use MariaDB 10.11+ with its mariadb client in an empty practice database. These dialect-specific examples do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Keep the sample database separate from real records.
Read the code step by step

items: `mariadb-dump` writes a logical SQL backup. The password option without a value prompts rather than exposing a password in command text.

blocks.text: The client asks for a password and writes a dump of the named practice database to a local file.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not put a real password directly in the command. A dump can contain private data; use sample records and test restoration separately.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Check that your practice dump file was created.
